primary_efficiency.definition: mean SUMO halted vehicles across eight controlled lanes
primary_efficiency.other_service_metrics: Descriptive outcomes; no additional optimization objective

execution_diagnosis.description: Uncapped raw proposals first pass threshold and stay filters, then coordinator cooldown. Cooldown-rejected proposals are distinct from all PP decisions. Complete accepted traces verify actual switch spacing.

interpretation: The A raw-target model and its frozen zero threshold replace the P/T model under the same S veto and450-second spacing. The primary measure is halted queue. Complete colliding runs contribute to all efficiency means; invalid runs disable means. These previously inspected seeds provide development evidence.

outcome.finding: The raw-target OOF improvement did not transfer to this closed-loop roster. Queue cost rises4.61% relative to X and5.33% relative to PP; all three seeds have higher queue cost than PP.
outcome.execution: Each seed executes exactly eight effective model switches, no model stays, and a minimum450-second intervention gap; the higher cost is not caused by more accepted interventions.
outcome.decision: Keep PP as the efficiency reference; this run does not support adopting V155A as an efficiency improvement over X.
limitations: One Cologne1 demand and three previously inspected development seeds.
Full-run costs do not identify the same-state advantage of individual actions or separate within450-second ranking errors from longer-lasting effects.

validation.real_result_summary: All three results match the frozen model/network/threshold and execution spacing; all six control bindings match. Primary cost denominators match3541 samples and eight lanes.
